facts.fact: 开篇主题句：中年魔法像生活一样只会低语（murmur），要么耐心听、要么莽撞错过提示；叙述者自比婚姻里 charge-forward 的教训。
facts.anchor: Magic rarely shouted. That was something important I’d picked up on somewhere along the way. Midlife magic tended to murmur

facts.fact: 女儿 Celeste 已带上 shadow mark（Book 12 结局），至今两周，叙述者还没消化它的含义。
facts.anchor: She wore the shadow mark now, and while I struggled to wrap my head around the implications, there was no hurrying what was to come

facts.fact: 小哥布林 Skonk 冲进校长办公室报信：图书馆两个女巫吵起来了。
facts.anchor: “There’s a kerfuffle in the library between two witches, and I have to warn you…I have never seen anything like it.”

facts.fact: 高个学生 Loretta 指控新同学 Alba（Ms. Darkness）：Stella 的 brewing 课小组作业搭档要用影子魔法，害她怕被退学。
facts.anchor: I was assigned to work on a team project with Ms. Darkness here, and she is going to get me flunked out of the Academy.

facts.fact: Alba 辩护：该咒语从影子取力不等于黑魔法，她家族常年在魔法里用影子。
facts.anchor: “It draws strength from shadows. That doesn’t make it dark,” Alba explained.

facts.fact: 争执的书来自图书馆今早凭空出现的书架段（原是石墙）；Twobble 证实 That section appeared this morning。
facts.anchor: I turned slowly to see what used to be a stone wall, now lined with shelves crammed with books.

facts.fact: Maeve 亲眼看见顶层书架间有影子一闪而过，Skonk 低喊「Maeve, did you see that?」——首次全名现身。
facts.anchor: I saw the faintest movement zip between the books on the top shelf, and I froze.

facts.fact: 双胞胎表亲哥布林 Twobble 与 Skonk 去书架后调查影子；Twobble 搬出「遇险要带上孪生兄弟的哥布林规则」。
facts.anchor: “This calls for having my twin by my side. Goblin rules when in danger.”

facts.fact: 上古吸血鬼 Lady Limora 调停：影子酿造非黑魔法，黑暗不天生邪恶，关键是你求魔法做什么；作业要求对立魔法属性共存。
facts.anchor: Darkness isn’t inherently evil any more than fire is inherently cruel. You have to remember that intent matters.

facts.fact: 尾场：Maeve 顺散落书本找到双胞胎，墙顶书架与天花板间卡着一枚餐盘大小的颤抖黑影，静止如走投无路的老鼠——「这大概是许多错误中的第一个」。
facts.anchor: It was no larger than a dinner plate.
